title: Lipidomic profile of porcine seminal extracellular vesicles
author: Martínez-Díaz, Pablo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Isolate sEVs from seminal plasma
steps.instruction: Isolate small and large seminal extracellular vesicles from porcine seminal plasma by applying serial centrifugations, followed by ultrafiltration, and then size‑exclusion chromatography.

steps.title: Perform lipidomic analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the isolated sEV subsets using high‑performance liquid chromatography coupled to high‑resolution mass spectrometry, generating raw .CDF files.
